scope: Public field contract only, not private canonical pair or oracle output. The script receives UI only; backend fields are for independent monitoring.

backend.cart: demo cart rows, sorted id: id,user_id,listing_id,quantity,created_at
backend.cart_total_cents: sum of actual listing price times demo cart quantity
backend.all_orders: all user order rows sorted id, for preservation checks
backend.order_items: all order item rows sorted id
backend.cart_rows_all: all users' cart rows sorted id
backend.listings: all original raw listing rows sorted id
backend.target_marketplace: release221 rows enriched with seller_username, seller_rating, seller_location; no canonical selection field
backend.table_hashes: per-table SHA256 over sorted actual rows; password values are never returned, but their changes affect the users hash
backend.table_counts: counts for all non-internal database tables

independent_ui.market_total: parsed visible marketplace total or null
independent_ui.filters: actual input/select values from market form
independent_ui.cart_rows: visible cart row release_href,seller_username,currency,unit_price_cents,text; quantities are not displayed by original cart UI
independent_ui.cart_total_cents: parsed visible USD summary total or null
independent_ui.checkout_disabled: actual Checkout disabled state or null
independent_ui.auth: cookie presence, signature/expiry verification flag and normalized subject only; never token value
independent_ui.traffic: passive local /api response metadata and safe cart/checkout response bodies; cart POST request listing_id/quantity only; no credential bodies or headers
independent_ui.dispatches: passive local API mutation dispatch path/method/state(pending,response,failed)/status and safe cart request IDs/quantity; unconfirmed dispatches forbid continuation

checkpoints.selection_committed: Required live review before first cart write: exact full filter universe, authenticated demo, budget-feasible independent optimum, zero business changes. It does not read or approve model notes as an answer; the actual chosen cart is checked later.
checkpoints.before_checkout: Required live review before the sole checkout: actual exact optimal pair each quantity1, unchanged active offers/prices, exact DOM and cart network values, required navigation history, two successful add requests, no premature order or unrelated mutation.
checkpoints.after_checkout: Final evaluate business checks; not an additional mandatory live gate.

privacy: Auth validation is privileged independent observation and must be declared in protocol. Script and public reviewer get no backend/secret token; verdict is limited to check IDs, booleans, public_summary.
